grahaInBhava: .input {$graha :entity kind=graha} .input {$bhava :integer select=ordinal} .match $bhava one {{{$graha} in the {$bhava}st house}} two {{{$graha} in the {$bhava}nd house}} few {{{$graha} in the {$bhava}rd house}} * {{{$graha} in the {$bhava}th house}}
bhavaInRashi: .input {$bhava :integer select=ordinal} .input {$rashi :entity kind=rashi} .match $bhava one {{the {$bhava}st house in {$rashi}}} two {{the {$bhava}nd house in {$rashi}}} few {{the {$bhava}rd house in {$rashi}}} * {{the {$bhava}th house in {$rashi}}}
chalitShift: {$graha :entity kind=graha} in house {$bhava :integer} by sign and house {$chalit :integer} by chalit
conjunction: .input {$count :integer} .input {$graha :entity kind=graha form=prose} .match $count 0 {{No planet conjoins {$graha}}} one {{One planet conjoins {$graha}}} * {{{$count} planets conjoin {$graha}}}
rashiNature: .input {$rashi :entity kind=rashi} .match $rashi m {{{$rashi} is a masculine sign}} f {{{$rashi} is a feminine sign}} * {{{$rashi} is a sign}}

strength.meets: .input {$graha :entity kind=graha} .input {$required :number minimumFractionDigits=2} .input {$reaches :string} .match $reaches yes {{{$graha} reaches the {$required} rupas its text requires}} * {{{$graha} falls short of the {$required} rupas its text requires}}

dasha.phase: .input {$graha :entity kind=graha} .input {$phase :string} .match $phase commencement {{{$graha}'s dasha gives its effects at its commencement}} middle {{{$graha}'s dasha gives its effects in its middle}} * {{{$graha}'s dasha gives its effects at its end}}
dasha.place: .input {$graha :entity kind=graha} .input {$nature :string} .match $nature BENEFIC {{{$graha} stands in an auspicious place}} MALEFIC {{{$graha} stands in an inauspicious place}} * {{{$graha} stands in a neutral place}}
dasha.points: {$graha :entity kind=graha} earns {$subhanka :number minimumFractionDigits=0} benefic and {$asubhanka :number minimumFractionDigits=0} malefic points
dasha.favour: .input {$graha :entity kind=graha} .input {$favour :string} .match $favour favourable {{{$graha}'s placement makes its dasha favourable}} unfavourable {{{$graha}'s placement makes its dasha unfavourable}} * {{{$graha}'s placement makes its dasha favourable and unfavourable at once}}

panchanga.tithi: the tithi is {$tithi :entity kind=tithi} of {$paksha :entity kind=paksha}
panchanga.pada: .input {$pada :integer select=ordinal} .input {$nakshatra :entity kind=nakshatra} .match $pada one {{the Moon stands in the {$pada}st pada of {$nakshatra}}} two {{the Moon stands in the {$pada}nd pada of {$nakshatra}}} few {{the Moon stands in the {$pada}rd pada of {$nakshatra}}} * {{the Moon stands in the {$pada}th pada of {$nakshatra}}}
panchanga.byDay: .input {$byDay :string} .match $byDay yes {{the birth fell by day}} * {{the birth fell by night}}

bhavaBala: .input {$bhava :integer select=ordinal} .input {$virupas :number minimumFractionDigits=2} .match $bhava one {{the {$bhava}st house weighs {$virupas} virupas}} two {{the {$bhava}nd house weighs {$virupas} virupas}} few {{the {$bhava}rd house weighs {$virupas} virupas}} * {{the {$bhava}th house weighs {$virupas} virupas}}
vimshopaka: .input {$graha :entity kind=graha} .input {$score :number minimumFractionDigits=2} .input {$scheme :string} .match $scheme shadvarga {{{$graha} scores {$score} vimshopaka over the six vargas}} saptavarga {{{$graha} scores {$score} vimshopaka over the seven vargas}} dashavarga {{{$graha} scores {$score} vimshopaka over the ten vargas}} * {{{$graha} scores {$score} vimshopaka over the sixteen vargas}}
ashtakavarga: .input {$graha :entity kind=graha} .input {$rashi :entity kind=rashi} .input {$bindus :integer} .match $bindus one {{{$graha} has {$bindus} bindu in {$rashi}}} * {{{$graha} has {$bindus} bindus in {$rashi}}}
sarvashtakavarga: .input {$rashi :entity kind=rashi} .input {$bindus :integer} .match $bindus one {{{$rashi} holds {$bindus} bindu in the sarvashtakavarga}} * {{{$rashi} holds {$bindus} bindus in the sarvashtakavarga}}
